biome_lab.name: Biome Lab
biome_lab.description: Two walkable timeline maps where the painted biome layer is the data. Biome_Spine encodes the full curriculum's ecological progression (sterile lab to QFEP nature, 19 zones). Biome_Zoo demonstrates 12 transition strategies. Together they validate the substrate dispatcher and the rendering ladder. See commons/biome_layers/DESIGN.md.
